Prealgebra · Lesson 6.1

Building Expressions

Solve this lesson →All lessons

Numbers and letters joined by the usual operations form an expression, like 3x+53x+5. A letter in an expression is called a variable, and it stands for a number you do not know or one that can change. Because a variable can be any number, one expression covers infinitely many cases instead of one. Arithmetic works the same, since a variable only stands for a number. Two conventions hold from here on. 3x3x means 3×x3×x, and x2x2 means x×xx×x.

Problem
A bead bracelet holds 33 colored beads per charm plus 44 fixed clasp beads, so a bracelet with nn charms has 3n+43n+4 beads. A customer orders 66 charms. Evaluate 3n+43n+4 at n=6n=6 by replacing nn with 66. How many beads are on that bracelet? Type the single number.
Show a hint
  • The expression is 3n+43n+4. To evaluate at n=6n=6, swap the letter nn for the number 66 everywhere it appears. You should be looking at 3(6)+43(6)+4.
  • Do the multiplication first. 3(6)3(6) means 3×63×6, which is 1818. Then add the 44 clasp beads.
Show the full solution
Replace nn with 66 in 3n+43n+4. 3(6)+4=18+4=22.3(6)+4=18+4=22. The bracelet has 2222​ beads. Build the expression once and it handles any order, since a new charm count is just a new value to drop in.
Problem
A diver's height in meters is 11−4t11−4t, where tt counts minutes of descent. An expression splits into terms separated by signs, here 1111 and −4t−4t. The number multiplying tt, carried with its sign, is the coefficient of tt. Read off the coefficient of tt and type that single value, sign included.
Show a hint
  • A subtraction is really an addition of a negative. Rewrite 11−4t11−4t as 11+(−4t)11+(−4t) so the sign on the tt term sits right out in the open.
  • The coefficient of tt is the whole number multiplying tt, the minus included. In −4t−4t that number is −4−4.
Show the full solution
Read 11−4t11−4t as 11+(−4t)11+(−4t). The term built from tt is −4t−4t, so the coefficient of tt is −4−4​. The minus belongs to the coefficient, not to the term next door. The lone 1111 is the constant term, the diver's starting height.
Problem
Different letters stand for different kinds, so xx and yy never combine. In 3x+5y+2x+y3x+5y+2x+y, gather the xx terms with each other and the yy terms with each other, remembering the lone yy means 1y1y. After you simplify, what is the coefficient of xx? Type that single value.
Show a hint
  • Sort the terms into two piles before you add anything. One pile holds the xx terms, the other holds the yy terms. A term with xx can never land in the yy pile, so the two letters get counted separately.
  • Add the xx terms by themselves, 3x+2x=5x3x+2x=5x, and leave the yy terms alone. The number sitting in front of xx is its coefficient, so read that off.
Show the full solution
Gather the xx terms, 3x+2x=5x3x+2x=5x, and the yy terms, remembering the lone yy means 1y1y, so 5y+y=6y5y+y=6y. That gives 3x+5y+2x+y=5x+6y.3x+5y+2x+y=5x+6y. The coefficient of xx is 55​. Different letters stand for different things, so an xx term and a yy term never combine.
Problem
Sort by shape before combining. In x2+5x+2x2+3x2+5x+2x2+3, the squares belong with squares and the strips with strips. A thing squared and the thing itself are different kinds of object, so x2x2 and 5x5x do not merge, which is exactly why counting terms is a real question. Write x2+5x+2x2+3x2+5x+2x2+3 in simplest form. How many terms does it have once fully simplified? Type the single count.
Show a hint
  • Sort the four pieces by their shape before you add anything. Which ones are square tiles x2x2, which is a strip 5x5x, and which is a plain number? Only pieces of the same shape can be combined.
  • Combine just the squares, x2+2x2=3x2x2+2x2=3x2, and leave 5x5x and 33 exactly where they are since nothing matches them. That gives 3x2+5x+33x2+5x+3. Now count the separate pieces joined by plus signs.
Show the full solution
Combine the squares, x2+2x2=3x2x2+2x2=3x2. The 5x5x and the 33 have nothing matching them, so x2+5x+2x2+3=3x2+5x+3.x2+5x+2x2+3=3x2+5x+3. The pieces are 3x23x2, 5x5x, and 33, which is 33​ terms. Squaring xx makes a different kind of object than xx itself, so those two never fold together.
Key idea
Terms, coefficients, and like terms. To evaluate an expression, replace every variable with its value and finish the arithmetic. An expression splits into terms at its plus and minus signs. The number in front of a term, sign included, is its coefficient, so a lone xx means 1x1x and −x−x means −1x−1x. A term that is a plain number is a constant. Two terms are like terms when their variable parts match exactly. You combine like terms by adding their coefficients, since x+x=2xx+x=2x. Terms whose variable parts differ at all, such as x2x2 beside xx, or xx beside yy, cannot be combined.
Fun fact
Nobody used a letter for the unknown until the 1500s. Viète introduced vowels, and Descartes shifted to x,y,zx,y,z, possibly because his printer had plenty of spare xx type blocks.
Problem
A school orders supply kits in two batches, 3(x+5)+4(x+8)3(x+5)+4(x+8), where each kit holds xx notebooks plus some pens. Distribute each group on its own, then combine the like terms so the order collapses to (notebooks) x x plus (pens). How many pens does the order come to? Type that single number.
Show a hint
  • Open each group separately. The first group 3(x+5)3(x+5) becomes 3x+153x+15, and the second group 4(x+8)4(x+8) becomes 4x+324x+32. The pens are the plain numbers with no xx attached.
  • Add the two plain-number pieces together. You have 1515 pens from the first batch and 3232 pens from the second, so the total number of pens is 15+3215+32.
Show the full solution
Distribute each group. 3(x+5)=3x+153(x+5)=3x+15 and 4(x+8)=4x+324(x+8)=4x+32, so the order reads 3x+15+4x+323x+15+4x+32. Combine like terms, 3x+4x=7x3x+4x=7x and 15+32=4715+32=47, which gives 7x+47.7x+47. The pens are the plain number with no xx on it, so the order comes to 4747​ pens.
Problem
This one leans on signs, so go slowly. Expand 5(z−3)+3(7−2z)5(z−3)+3(7−2z), letting each subtraction ride along with its term and remembering 3×(−2z)=−6z3×(−2z)=−6z. Combine the like terms all the way to one cleanest form, then read off the coefficient of zz. Type that single value, sign included.
Show a hint
  • Line up your four pieces, 5z−15+21−6z5z−15+21−6z, then sort them into z terms and plain numbers. The coefficient of zz is whatever number ends up sitting in front of zz once you have gathered 5z5z and −6z−6z together.
  • Add the z terms by adding their coefficients, 5+(−6)=−15+(−6)=−1, so the z part becomes −z−z. Writing −z−z is the same as writing −1z−1z, so the coefficient is that −1−1.
Show the full solution
Distribute both groups, letting the subtractions travel with their terms. 5(z−3)=5z−155(z−3)=5z−15, and 3(7−2z)=21−6z3(7−2z)=21−6z since 3×(−2z)=−6z3×(−2z)=−6z. That gives 5z−15+21−6z5z−15+21−6z. The z terms combine as 5z−6z=−z5z−6z=−z, and the constants as −15+21=6−15+21=6, so the simplest form is −z+6−z+6. Since −z−z means −1z−1z, the coefficient of zz is −1−1​.
Problem
A subtraction in front of a group flips the sign of everything inside, since the multiplier carries its minus into every piece. Take 8−2(x−5)8−2(x−5). The −2−2 lands on both the xx and the −5−5, so the −5−5 becomes +10+10, not −10−10. Distribute, combine the constants, and the expression collapses to (something) x x plus a constant. What is the constant term once fully simplified? Type that single value.
Show a hint
  • The number multiplying the group is the whole −2−2, not just 22. Send it onto both pieces inside, so −2×x−2×x and −2×(−5)−2×(−5). Watch what happens to that second sign.
  • A negative times a negative is positive, so −2×(−5)=+10−2×(−5)=+10. That gives 8−2x+108−2x+10. Add the two loose numbers 8+108+10 to get the constant, and read it off.
Show the full solution
The −2−2 multiplies both pieces inside, so −2×x=−2x−2×x=−2x and −2×(−5)=+10−2×(−5)=+10. 8−2(x−5)=8−2x+10=−2x+18.8−2(x−5)=8−2x+10=−2x+18. The constant term is 1818​. The usual slip is sending only the 22 inside and landing on −10−10, but the minus rides along with it.
Key idea
Distribute to every term. When a number multiplies a group in parentheses, multiply every term inside by it, not just the first. In 3(x+4)=3x+123(x+4)=3x+12, the 33 multiplies both terms. A minus sign in front of a group means multiplying by −1−1, so every term inside changes sign, and −(x−5)=−x+5−(x−5)=−x+5. Almost every distribution error is a term that never got multiplied.
Problem
Two expressions are equivalent when they agree for every value of the variable. Staring at them is not proof, so use this grading check. Build the difference A−BA−B and plug in a value. If they truly are equivalent, that difference must come out 00. Let A=2(3x+4)+xA=2(3x+4)+x and B=7x+8B=7x+8. Compute A−BA−B at x=5x=5 and type the single number you get.
Show a hint
  • Evaluating at x=5x=5 means replacing every xx with 55. Find the value of A=2(3x+4)+xA=2(3x+4)+x at x=5x=5, then the value of B=7x+8B=7x+8 at x=5x=5, and finally subtract the second from the first.
  • At x=5x=5, A=2(3⋅5+4)+5=2⋅19+5=43A=2(3⋅5+4)+5=2⋅19+5=43 and B=7⋅5+8=43B=7⋅5+8=43. The difference is 43−4343−43.
Show the full solution
At x=5x=5, A=2(3⋅5+4)+5=2⋅19+5=43A=2(3⋅5+4)+5=2⋅19+5=43 and B=7⋅5+8=43B=7⋅5+8=43, so A−B=43−43=0A−B=43−43=0​. Simplifying AA shows this was never luck. 2(3x+4)+x=6x+8+x=7x+82(3x+4)+x=6x+8+x=7x+8, which is exactly BB, so the difference is 00 at every value of xx.
Problem
The target is 6n+106n+10, and four suspects line up beside it: 2(3n+5)2(3n+5), 3(2n+4)3(2n+4), 5+6n+55+6n+5, and 10+6n10+6n. Simplify each one until you can compare it cleanly with 6n+106n+10. How many of the four are equivalent to 6n+106n+10? Type the single count.
Show a hint
  • To test a suspect, rewrite it in the same plain form as the target, which is some number of nn plus a constant. For the ones with parentheses, multiply the outside number by each piece inside. For the ones that are already a string of terms, gather the loose numbers together.
  • Suspect one becomes 6n+106n+10, a match. Suspect two becomes 6n+126n+12, so its constant is off by 2 and it fails. Suspect three has 5+5=105+5=10 so it is 6n+106n+10, a match. Suspect four is 10+6n10+6n, the same two pieces just written in the other order, which is still a match. Now count the matches.
Show the full solution
Rewrite each suspect and line it up against 6n+106n+10. 2(3n+5)=6n+102(3n+5)=6n+10, a match. 3(2n+4)=6n+123(2n+4)=6n+12, and 12≠1012=10, so it fails. 5+6n+5=6n+105+6n+5=6n+10, a match. 10+6n10+6n is the same two pieces in the other order, a match. That is 33​ of the four. Reordering a sum never changes its value, so writing the constant first does not make a new expression.
Key idea
Equivalence. Two expressions are equivalent when they agree for every value of the variable. If two expressions disagree at even one value, they are not equivalent. Matching at one value, or even a few, proves nothing. The only sure check is to rewrite both to the same simplest form. Reordering a sum keeps its value, so x+7x+7 and 7+x7+x are the same, but x−7x−7 and 7−x7−x are not, because subtraction is not symmetric.
Problem
Coefficients do not have to be whole numbers. A fraction can sit in front of a variable, and combining such terms is the same common-denominator move from Chapter 4 with an xx riding along. The terms 2x332x​ and 5x775x​ are like terms, since both carry a single xx. Combine 2x3+5x732x​+75x​ into one term, then state the coefficient of xx as a fraction in lowest terms, typed as a over b.
Show a hint
  • Both terms are like terms, so think of this as adding the coefficients 2332​ and 5775​ while the xx just rides along. To add those fractions you need a common denominator for 33 and 77.
  • A common denominator of 33 and 77 is 2121. Rewrite 2x332x​ as 14x212114x​ and 5x775x​ as 15x212115x​, then add the numerators over 2121. The coefficient of xx is whatever fraction lands in front.
Show the full solution
A common denominator of 33 and 77 is 2121. Rewrite each term with denominator 2121, so 2x3=14x2132x​=2114x​ and 5x7=15x2175x​=2115x​. Now add the numerators over the shared denominator. 2x3+5x7=14x21+15x21=29x2132x​+75x​=2114x​+2115x​=2129x​ That single term is 29x212129x​, and its coefficient of xx is 29212129​. Since 2929 is prime and does not divide 2121, the fraction is already in lowest terms. The coefficient of xx is 29/2129/21​.
Key idea
Fractional coefficients. A coefficient can be a fraction, so 2x332x​ means 2332​ times xx. Adding two terms like this is the same common-denominator work you already know, and the xx itself never changes. Find the common denominator, rewrite each coefficient over it, add the numerators, and write the xx back beside the answer.
Problem
Sometimes the pieces you are adding live over different denominators, and one piece can be an expression. Combine a2+6a−542a​+46a−5​ onto a common bottom, then write the result as a coefficient of aa plus a constant, like 2a−542a−45​. In that clean form, type the constant term as a fraction in lowest terms, with its sign.
Show a hint
  • The two denominators are 22 and 44, and 44 is a multiple of 22, so 44 is the common bottom. Rewrite a22a​ over 44 by doubling top and bottom, and leave 6a−5446a−5​ exactly as it is. Then add the numerators over that one shared 44.
  • You have 2a4+6a−54=2a+6a−54=8a−5442a​+46a−5​=42a+6a−5​=48a−5​. Split that into two fractions, 8a4−54=2a−5448a​−45​=2a−45​. The constant term is the piece with no aa attached.
Show the full solution
The common denominator is 44, since 44 is a multiple of 22. Double the top and bottom of the first piece, leave the second alone, and add over the shared bottom. a2+6a−54=2a4+6a−54=2a+6a−54=8a−542a​+46a−5​=42a​+46a−5​=42a+6a−5​=48a−5​ Split that back into an aa piece and a number piece, 8a4−54=2a−5448a​−45​=2a−45​. The constant term is −5/4−5/4​. The minus stays with the constant because the 55 was being subtracted inside the numerator.
Problem
This one expression gathers the whole lesson, a piece scaled by a fraction, a piece scaled by a whole number, and a piece over a denominator. Simplify 12(4x+6)+3(x−1)+x−5321​(4x+6)+3(x−1)+3x−5​ all the way down to the form (something) x x plus (something), then report the coefficient of xx as a fraction in lowest terms, typed as a over b.
Show a hint
  • Knock out one group at a time before you mix anything. Half of 4x+64x+6 gives 2x+32x+3. Three times x−1x−1 gives 3x−33x−3, and watch that the 33 hits the −1−1 too. The last group x−533x−5​ is one quantity divided by 33, so it splits into x3−533x​−35​.
  • Now sweep up only the xx terms and ignore the constants for this question. You have 2x2x, 3x3x, and x33x​, so the coefficient of xx is 2+3+132+3+31​. Put 2+3=52+3=5 over a denominator of 33 to add the last piece, which makes 153+13315​+31​.
Show the full solution
Take the three groups one at a time. 12(4x+6)=2x+321​(4x+6)=2x+3, then 3(x−1)=3x−33(x−1)=3x−3, then x−53=x3−533x−5​=3x​−35​. Lining them up gives 2x+3+3x−3+x3−532x+3+3x−3+3x​−35​. The xx coefficients add as 2+3+13=153+13=1632+3+31​=315​+31​=316​, and the constants give 3−3−53=−533−3−35​=−35​, so the expression is 163x−53316​x−35​ and the coefficient of xx is 16/316/3​. It is already in lowest terms, since 1616 and 33 share no factor.

Practice these ideas

Practice
A weather balloon's altitude in meters is 13−7p13−7p, where pp is the number of minutes a valve has been venting. The number multiplying a variable, carried with its sign, is its coefficient. State the coefficient of pp and type that single value, sign included.
Show the solution
Reading the subtraction as adding a negative, 13−7p13−7p is 13+(−7p)13+(−7p). The term built from pp is −7p−7p, so the coefficient of pp is −7−7​. The minus belongs to the coefficient. The other term, 1313, is the constant.
Practice
A print run is modeled by 19−5q19−5q, where qq counts paper jams. The piece 5q5q shifts as jams shift, but one piece does not change at all. That unchanging number is the constant term. State the constant term of 19−5q19−5q and type that single number.
Show the solution
The two terms of 19−5q19−5q are 5q5q, whose value shifts whenever qq shifts, and 1919, a plain number with no variable attached. The constant term is the one with no variable, so it is 1919​. Setting q=0q=0 makes it visible, since 19−5(0)=1919−5(0)=19.
Practice
A lone variable carries a hidden 11 in front, so mm means 1m1m. Combine the like terms in 3m+m+5m3m+m+5m into a single term, then type the coefficient of mm.
Show the solution
Every term here is a number of copies of mm, so they are like terms and can be merged. Reading the lone mm as 1m1m, the expression becomes 3m+1m+5m3m+1m+5m. Add the numbers in front, 3+1+5=93+1+5=9, and keep the mm. The simplified expression is 9m9m. The coefficient of mm is 99​.
Practice
Tally each kind of term on its own, the plain numbers in one pile and the xx terms in another. Simplify 8+2x+5+4x8+2x+5+4x, then read off the constant term and type that single value.
Show the solution
Group the like terms first. The plain numbers are 88 and 55, and the xx terms are 2x2x and 4x4x. Combine each group on its own. The numbers give 8+5=138+5=13, and the xx terms give 2x+4x=6x2x+4x=6x. Putting both groups back together, the expression in simplest form is 6x+136x+13. The constant term is the piece with no xx attached to it, which is 1313. So the value you type is 1313​.
Practice
Square tiles each cover x2x2 and thin tiles each cover xx, and the two kinds never combine because x2x2 and xx are different objects. Gather each kind in 5x2+2x+3x2+x5x2+2x+3x2+x, write it in simplest form, then count how many terms remain.
Show the solution
Keep the two kinds of tiles separate while you combine. The square tiles give 5x2+3x2=8x25x2+3x2=8x2, and the thin x-tiles give 2x+x=3x2x+x=3x. Putting the piles back together, the simplest form is 8x2+3x8x2+3x. A term is one chunk separated by a plus or minus sign, so 8x28x2 is one term and 3x3x is another. They cannot merge into a single piece because a square tile is not the same kind of tile as a thin one. That leaves two terms. 22​
Practice
Since aa and bb stand for different things, an aa term and a bb term can never merge. Combine only the matching kinds in 6a+2b+a+3b6a+2b+a+3b, write the result in simplest form, then type how many terms are left.
Show the solution
Collect the pieces of the same kind. The aa terms give 6a+a=7a6a+a=7a, and the bb terms give 2b+3b=5b2b+3b=5b, so 6a+2b+a+3b=7a+5b.6a+2b+a+3b=7a+5b. That is two separate pieces joined by addition, so the count is 22​. An aa bundle and a bb bundle measure different things, so they never merge into one term.
Practice
Expand 8(3x+2)8(3x+2) by handing the 88 to every piece inside, so it lands on both the 3x3x and the 22. In the result, the number multiplying xx is its coefficient. What is the coefficient of xx? Type that single value.
Show the solution
Hand the 88 to every piece inside the group. 8×3x=24x8×3x=24x and 8×2=168×2=16. Putting those together, the expanded expression is 24x+1624x+16. No parentheses are left, so it is in simplest form. The term holding the xx is 24x24x, and the number multiplying xx is 2424. That number is the coefficient of xx. So the coefficient is 2424​.
Practice
Distribute across each group in 2(x+6)+5(x+1)2(x+6)+5(x+1), then combine the like terms into simplest form. Read off the constant term, the lone number with no xx attached, and type that single value.
Show the solution
Distribute each group on its own. The first group gives 2(x+6)=2x+122(x+6)=2x+12, and the second gives 5(x+1)=5x+55(x+1)=5x+5. Putting those together, the expression is 2x+12+5x+52x+12+5x+5. Now combine like terms. The xx terms are 2x2x and 5x5x, which add to 7x7x. The plain numbers are 1212 and 55, which add to 1717. So in simplest form the expression is 7x+177x+17. The constant term is the number standing alone with no xx, which is 1717. So the answer is 1717​.
Practice
Distribute each number across its own parentheses in 6(n−2)+4(5−3n)6(n−2)+4(5−3n), letting every sign ride along, then collect the like terms. In simplest form, read off the coefficient of nn and type that single value, sign included.
Show the solution
Distribute each factor across its parentheses, keeping every sign attached to its term. The first chunk gives 6(n−2)=6n−126(n−2)=6n−12. The second chunk gives 4(5−3n)=20−12n4(5−3n)=20−12n, where the 44 multiplies both the 55 and the −3n−3n. So far the expression reads 6n−12+20−12n6n−12+20−12n. Now collect like terms. The nn terms are 6n6n and −12n−12n, which combine to −6n−6n. The plain numbers are −12−12 and 2020, which combine to 88. The simplest form is −6n+8−6n+8. The coefficient of nn is the number multiplying nn, which is −6−6. −6−6​
Practice
In 20−3(2x−4)20−3(2x−4), the −3−3 distributes across the group and flips the sign of every piece inside because it is negative. Simplify into a number plus a multiple of xx, then find the constant term, the plain number with no xx, and type that single value.
Show the solution
Distribute the −3−3 into 2x−42x−4. You get −3×2x=−6x−3×2x=−6x and −3×(−4)=+12−3×(−4)=+12, so the expression becomes 20−6x+1220−6x+12. The plain numbers combine, 20+12=3220+12=32, while −6x−6x has no partner, leaving 32−6x32−6x. The constant term is 3232​. A negative multiplier flips the sign of every piece inside, which is where most slips happen.
Practice
Two expressions are equivalent when their difference A−BA−B is 00 for every value of xx. Let A=3(2x+5)A=3(2x+5) and B=6x+15B=6x+15. Evaluate A−BA−B at x=4x=4 by replacing every xx with 44, and type the single number you get.
Show the solution
At x=4x=4, A=3(2⋅4+5)=3⋅13=39A=3(2⋅4+5)=3⋅13=39 and B=6⋅4+15=39B=6⋅4+15=39, so A−B=39−39=0A−B=39−39=0​. Distributing shows it could not have come out any other way, since 3(2x+5)=6x+153(2x+5)=6x+15 is exactly BB, so the difference is 00 for every value of xx.
Practice
The target is 8x+128x+12. Simplify each of 4(2x+3)4(2x+3), 2(4x+6)2(4x+6), 8x+68x+6, and 12+8x12+8x, then compare with the target. How many of the four are equivalent to 8x+128x+12? Type the single count.
Show the solution
Simplify each expression and compare it to the target 8x+128x+12. For the first, 4(2x+3)=8x+124(2x+3)=8x+12, which matches. For the second, 2(4x+6)=8x+122(4x+6)=8x+12, which also matches. For the third, 8x+68x+6 is already simplified, and its constant is 66 instead of 1212, so it does not match. For the fourth, 12+8x12+8x is the same two terms as 8x+128x+12 written in the other order, and order does not change the value, so it matches. Three of the four are equivalent to the target. 33​
Practice
Two dials add 5x665x​ and x44x​ to a score, where xx is the number of presses. Combine 5x6+x465x​+4x​ into one term using a common denominator of 1212, keeping the xx. State the coefficient of xx as a fraction in lowest terms, typed as a over b.
Show the solution
Rewrite each fraction with denominator 1212. Since 5x6=10x1265x​=1210x​ and x4=3x124x​=123x​, the sum becomes 10x12+3x12=13x12.1210x​+123x​=1213x​. The combined term is 13x121213x​. The coefficient of xx is the number multiplying it, which is 13121213​. Since 1313 is prime and does not divide 1212, this fraction is already in lowest terms. The coefficient is 13/1213/12​.
Practice
A tiled border uses 3(2s+3)3(2s+3) tiles in one row, 2(s−1)2(s−1) in another, plus 55 corner tiles, where ss is a size setting. Build one expression for the total, simplify it, then evaluate at s=4s=4 by replacing every ss with 44. Type the single number you get.
Show the solution
Start by expanding each grouped piece. The first row is 3(2s+3)=6s+93(2s+3)=6s+9, and the second row is 2(s−1)=2s−22(s−1)=2s−2. Adding everything, including the 55 corner tiles, gives 6s+9+2s−2+56s+9+2s−2+5. Combine the like terms. The ss terms give 6s+2s=8s6s+2s=8s, and the plain numbers give 9−2+5=129−2+5=12, so the simplified total is 8s+128s+12. Now evaluate at s=4s=4 by replacing ss with 44, which gives 8⋅4+12=32+12=448⋅4+12=32+12=44. 4444​
